catalog_quote: Bellamy 2018 p.18: "Its phonological inventory comprises 22 consonants and six vowels, and has no tone. ... Stress can fall on the first or second syllable of the root (where it is disyllabic), with a preference for the second." pp.21–22: "Stress can occur on the first or second syllable the root, being more common on the second syllable in disyllabic roots. audit.reasoning: (1) Quotes verified verbatim at the stated pages in both held files. (2) The classification LEXICAL (stress on σ1 or σ2 of the root, lexically chosen, contrastive minimal pairs, σ2 majority; alternative framing root/stem-final with lexical exceptions) is correct and is now independently confirmed by four sources fetched sources in this audit: Chamoreau 2002 fn.11, Chamoreau 2017 p.671, Chamoreau 2023 §2 (stem-final default, σ1 'sometimes', pairs wéra-/wera-, kára-/kara-, píri-/piri-), and Agustín Diego 2016 ch. III (749-word corpus: 520 σ2 vs 222 σ1, choice 'libre o léxica', spectrogram-verified minimal pairs). WALS Initial/Fixed (source Foster 1969) remains contradicted by every description opened. sources.quote: 'Stems end in a vowel and generally receive the accent on this vowel, that is, the accent indicates the morphological right edge of the stem. Nevertheless, the accent may sometimes appear on the first syllable of the stem: compare … wéra-ni ‘go out’ / wera-ni ‘cry’; kára-ni ‘fly’ / kara-ni ‘write’; píri-ni ‘approach’ / piri-ni ‘sing’. I indicate the accent only when it appears on the first syllable.' fn.3: 'The accent appears on the first or second syllable of the stem.'

sources.quote: p.55: 'la ventana acentual del p’urhépecha está restringida a la primera o segunda sílaba de la raíz, ubicada siempre a principio de palabra por la ausencia de morfología prefijal … el acento ocurre en la primera o segunda sílaba de la raíz dentro de la palabra prosódica (existen muy pocas excepciones de acento en la tercera sílaba [pirirántani, at’arántani])'. p.63: 'sin ningún elemento visible que determine la elección sobre dónde colocar el acento mas que la cuestión léxica … también puede ser contrastivo … pares mínimos acentuales: ˈka.ɾa.ni ‘volar’ / ka.ˈɾa.ni ‘escribir’; ˈka.na.ɾa.ni / k

Also: final vowel elided 'dans les contextes où elle n’est pas accentuée'. Segmental phonology paper; no further stress analysis.
